Questions 1–10

Complete the form below.

Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

Customer details
Name: Sophie Bird Occupation:
Reason for travel today:
Journey information
Name of station returning to:
Type of ticket purchased: standard ticket
Cost of ticket: £
When ticket was purchased: yesterday
Where ticket was bought:
Satisfaction with journey
Most satisfied with: the wifi
Least satisfied with: the this morning
Satisfaction with station facilities
Most satisfied with: how much was provided
Least satisfied with: lack of seats, particularly on the
Neither satisfied nor dissatisfied with: the available

transcript.en: Hello. Do you mind if I ask you some questions about your journey today? We're doing a customer satisfaction survey.
transcript.zh: 您好。您介不介意我问您一些关于今天的旅行的问题?我们正在做客户满意度调查。

transcript.en: Yes. OK. I've got about ten minutes before my train home leaves. I'm on a day trip.
transcript.zh: 没问题。你问吧。十分钟后我要搭乘火车回家。我参加的是一日行。

transcript.en: Great. Thank you. So first of all, could you tell me your name?
transcript.zh: 太好了。谢谢您。首先,请问您叫什么名字?

transcript.en: It's Sophie Bird.
transcript.zh: 我叫苏菲·伯德

transcript.en: Thank you. And would you mind telling me what you do?
transcript.zh: 谢谢。请问您可以告诉我您的职业吗?

transcript.en: I'm a journalist.
transcript.zh: 我是个记者。

transcript.en: Oh really? That must be interesting.
transcript.zh: 真的吗?那一定很有趣。

transcript.en: Yes. It is.
transcript.zh: 是的。的确是这样。

transcript.en: So was the reason for your visit here today work?
transcript.zh: 您今天来这里是为了工作吗?

transcript.en: Actually, it's my day off. I came here to do some shopping.
transcript.zh: 实际上,今天我休班。我来这里是为了购物。

transcript.en: Oh right.
transcript.zh: 知道了。

transcript.en: But I do sometimes come here for work.
transcript.zh: 但是我偶尔到这里工作。

transcript.en: OK. Now I'd like to ask some questions about your journey today, if that's OK.
transcript.zh: 嗯。现在如果可以的话,我想问您一些关于今天旅行的问题。

transcript.en: Yes. No problem.
transcript.zh: 你说吧。没问题。

transcript.en: Right, so can you tell me which station you're travelling back to?
transcript.zh: 好的,您能告诉我您要回到哪个车站吗?

transcript.en: Staunfirth, where I live.
transcript.zh: 斯当佛斯,我在那里住。

transcript.en: Can I just check the spelling? S-T-A-U-N-F-I-R-T-H?
transcript.zh: 请问是这么拼吗?S-T-A-U-N-F-I-R-T-H对吗

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: And you travelled from there this morning?
transcript.zh: 您是这个早上过来的吗?

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: OK, good. Next, can I ask what kind of ticket you bought? I assume it wasn't a season ticket, as you don't travel every day.
transcript.zh: 好的,知道了。接下来,能问下您买的哪种票?我猜不是季票,因为您也不是每天都来。

transcript.en: That's right. No, I just got a normal return ticket. I don't have a rail card so I didn't get any discount. I keep meaning to get one because it's a lot cheaper.
transcript.zh: 是的。我买的就是普通的往返票。我没有铁路卡所以没有打折。我一直想要弄一张因为那样会便宜很多。

transcript.en: Yes - you'd have saved 20% on your ticket today. So you paid the full price for your ticket?
transcript.zh: 是的。如果有的话,您的票价今天可以打八折。所以您买的是全价票了?

transcript.en: I paid £23.70.
transcript.zh: 我花了23.70磅。

transcript.en: OK. Do you think that's good value for money?
transcript.zh: 知道了。您觉得物有所值吗?

transcript.en: Not really. I think it's too much for a journey that only takes 45 minutes.
transcript.zh: 并没有。我觉得对于一趟只有45分钟的行程来说太贵了

transcript.en: Yes, that's one of the main complaints we get. So, you didn't buy your ticket in advance?
transcript.zh: 是的,我们收到的最多的抱怨也是这个。那么,您没有提前买票吗?

transcript.en: No. I know it's cheaper if you buy a week in advance but I didn't know I was coming then.
transcript.zh: 没有。我知道提前一周买票会更便宜但是我那时候并不知道我会来。

transcript.en: I know. You can't always plan ahead. So, did you buy it this morning?
transcript.zh: 了解了。有的事儿很难提前计划。那么,您是今天早上买的票吗

transcript.en: No, it was yesterday.
transcript.zh: 不是,是昨天。

transcript.en: Right. And do you usually buy your tickets at the station?
transcript.zh: 好的。您经常在车站买票吗?

transcript.en: Well, I do usually but the ticket office closes early and I hate using ticket machines. I think ticket offices should be open for longer hours. There's always a queue for the machines and they're often out of order.
transcript.zh: 我确实经常在售票处买票,但是售票处很早就关门。我不喜欢用售票机。我觉得售票处的营业时间应该更长。售票机前很多人排队，而且常常出现故障。

transcript.en: A lot of customers are saying the same thing.
transcript.zh: 很多顾客和您说的一样。

transcript.en: So to answer your question ... I got an e-ticket online.
transcript.zh: 至于你刚才的问题。我在网上买的电子票。

transcript.en: OK. Thank you. Now I'd like to ask you about your satisfaction with your journey. So what would you say you were most satisfied with today?
transcript.zh: 了解了。谢谢您。现在我想问您一些关于旅行满意度的问题。今天的旅行您最满意的是什么?

transcript.en: Well, I like the wifi on the train. It's improved a lot. It makes it easier for me to work if I want to.
transcript.zh: 火车上提供无线网络,我很喜欢。网速提高很多。如果我要工作的话也更方便。

transcript.en: That's the first time today anyone's mentioned that. It's good to get some positive feedback on that.
transcript.zh: 今天还没有人说到这个。能得到一些积极的反馈真好。

transcript.en: Mmm.
transcript.zh: 嗯。

transcript.en: And, is there anything you weren't satisfied with?
transcript.zh: 今天有什么不满意的吗?

transcript.en: Well, normally, the trains run on time and are pretty reliable but today there was a delay: the train was about 15 minutes behind schedule.
transcript.zh: 平时火车总是准时到站,这一点很值得信赖。但是今天火车晚点了,晚了15分钟。

transcript.en: OK. I'll put that down. Now I'd also like to ask about the facilities at this station . You've probably noticed that the whole station's been upgraded. What are you most satisfied with?
transcript.zh: 好的。我会记下来。现在我想知道有关火车站设施的情况。您也许已经注意到了整个火车站已经翻新升级了。您最满意的是什么?

transcript.en: I think the best thing is that they've improved the amount of information about train times etc. that's given to passengers - it's much clearer - before there was only one board and I couldn't always see it properly- which was frustrating.
transcript.zh: 我觉得最好的就是他们增加了有关火车班次时间等等的信息。旅客们看时间看得更清楚了。之前只有一个板子,我经常看不清上面的字,这很令人沮丧。

transcript.en: That's good. And is there anything you're not satisfied with?
transcript.zh: 那就好。有什么不满意的吗?

transcript.en: Let's see ... I think things have generally improved a lot. The trains are much more modern and I like the new cafe. But one thing is that there aren't enough places to sit down, especially on the platforms.
transcript.zh: 我想想。我觉得普遍来说已经完善了很多。火车更加现代化了,我也喜欢新的咖啡厅。但是确实有一个不满意的地方,那就是车站,尤其是站台上的座椅不够。

transcript.en: OK - so I'll put 'seating' down, shall I, as the thing you're least satisfied with?
transcript.zh: 好的,我把它记成您最不满意的事项?

transcript.en: Yes. OK.
transcript.zh: 可以。没问题

transcript.en: Can I ask your opinion about some of the other facilities? We'd like feedback on whether people are satisfied, dissatisfied or neither satisfied nor dissatisfied.
transcript.zh: 我能问问您对其他设施的看法吗?我们希望得到客户的回应,不管是满意还是不满意还是无意见。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 可以。

transcript.en: What about the parking at the station?
transcript.zh: 车站停车方便吗?

transcript.en: Well to be honest, I don't really have an opinion as I never use it.
transcript.zh: 说实话,因为我没用过,我也没什么看法。

transcript.en: So, neither satisfied nor dissatisfied for that then.
transcript.zh: 那就是无意见

transcript.en: Yes, I suppose so ...
transcript.zh: 是的，我觉得是

transcript.en: OK, and what about ... ?
transcript.zh: 好的，那……
